text:
maria.fin: FYI ArborHealth submitted a payment hold. They say INV-2026-0890 charged platform fee twice. Can someone grab the metering export and confirm whether this is a dup SKU or a support proration bug?

olivia.revops: On it. Do we have the invoice lines or the PDF? If it's a migration overlap we've seen this pattern before.

sam.am: Context: they migrated to a new private contract and upgraded support mid-contract. SEs gave them a short validation window that we agreed to comp. Could be the migration created a new PLATFORM-FEE SKU and didn't retire the old one.

maria.fin: Invoice snippets pasted below:
```
INV-2026-0890:
 - line 3 PRIVATE-LICENSE-ARBR-01 qty 1 $12000 annual
 - line 4 PLATFORM-FEE-ARBR-01 qty 1 $12000 annual
 - line 5 SUPPORT-PREM-ARBR qty 1 $3600 annual
 - line 6 PLATFORM-FEE-ARBR-01 qty 1 $12000 annual (appears dup)
```

jeff.finance: If two platform_fee lines are full-year that's wrong. I'll look at contract/commit mapping.

billing-bot: [system] Metering export available: /billing/exports/2026-03/arbor_20260312.csv uploaded at 2026-03-12T09:03Z by billing-scheduler

lina.se: I pulled the CSV. Two active commitments show up for overlapping ranges: commit A-777 (2025-04-01 -> 2026-03-31) and B-888 (2026-02-10 -> 2027-02-09). Both emitted PLATFORM_FEE pro-rata lines for the overlap window.

olivia.revops: That explains duplicate charge. Migration script appears to have created the new SKU but didn't mark the prior one as ended for billing. I'll open an engineering ticket.

eng-ticket-bot: [system] ENG-4123 created by olivia.revops: "migration script incorrectly leaving legacy platform_fee SKUs active during contract wrap". Link: https://eng.redwood/ENG-4123

sam.am: Customer expectation: 7-day complimentary overlap for validation (2026-02-10 -> 2026-02-16). Procurement is holding the invoice. We need to issue a corrected invoice + credit memo ASAP.

maria.fin: Jeff, can finance issue a credit and corrected invoice? Also confirm support billing: did we bill a full Premium year or pro-rate from upgrade date?

jeff.finance: Scanned billing records: support was billed as full Premium for 2026-02-10 -> 2027-02-09 due to the migration script defaulting support_start to contract_start. We'll pro-rate support to start 2026-02-11 (actual upgrade) and credit the overcharge. Drafting credit memo now.

olivia.revops: Root cause: migration tool maps commit -> sku_id and on contract wrap doesn't emit an "end_date" for the legacy sku if the new commit is created programmatically. Patch in review will add explicit retire call and add unit test asserting "no more than one platform_fee sku active for customer at any day".

maria.fin: Lina, can you calc the numbers so Jeff can cut the memo?

lina.se: Calculating: platform fee $12,000 annual -> daily $32.8767. Duplicate overlap window charged 50 days (2026-02-10 -> 2026-03-31) => $1,643.84 (rounded). Complimentary validation week 7 days => $230.14. Support overcharge (full vs pro-rate) = $3,600 full - pro-rated from 2026-02-11 (~$3,589.04?) wait will compute precisely and post.

lina.se: Support calc: premium $3,600 annual -> daily $9.8630. Charged full year but should have started 2026-02-11 -> 2027-02-10 (358 days billed) vs 365 -> customer was charged 365 days; credit = 7 days * $9.8630 = $69.04.

lina.se: Totals: platform duplicate credit $1,643.84 + complimentary week $230.14 + support credit $69.04 = $1,943.02. Rounding to cents -> $1,943.02.

sam.am: I'll forward the SE sign-off email for the complimentary week to billing.

jeff.finance: Credit memo created CREDIT-2026-0460.pdf and corrected invoice INV-2026-0890A drafted. Uploaded to /billing/credits and /billing/invoices/drafts. Will request approval.

maria.fin: Approve once I sign off. Also we should check recent migrations in last 30 days for same pattern. Olivia, please include a query to surface customers with overlapping commits.

olivia.revops: Will do, including a quick alert to the migrations on the next canary run. Patch will be released to staging and canary for 48 hours.

billing-bot: [system] Credit memo CREDIT-2026-0460 uploaded at 2026-03-13T16:05Z by jeff.finance

jeff.finance: Applied credit and pushed INV-2026-0890A to customer portal. Notified customer and cc'd account team.

sam.am: Customer replied: "Thanks, invoice looks correct now. We'll pay once portal reflects the credit." :thumbsup:

maria.fin: Thanks team. Please mark account note and close related billing ticket. We'll review migration impacts at Friday's finance sync.

eng-ticket-bot: [system] ENG-4123 status updated to "in review" by olivia.revops

maria.fin: Great, closing thread.
